w: Swamishri arrived at Mwanza airport at 11.55 am. He was welcomed at a grand evening assembly held in his honor.
In the evening assembly the Mayor of Birmingham, Mr. Bernard Kincade, presented a 'Key to the City' to Swamishri. The devotees also honored Lord Harikrishna Maharaj.

In the evening assembly the students of 'Pramukh Swami Vidya Mandir' - a primary school, presented speeches in Sanskrit and Gujarati, a dance and a march and a drama depicting life in a gurukul. Finally, Swamishri addressed the assembly.

A devotee came with his son to meet Swamishri. The youth had acquired a gold medal in his B.Sc. He wanted to study further and do M.Sc., but he was depressed. "What is the cause of your depression?" Swamishri asked.
"I want to become like Dhirubhai Ambani and elevate our country," the youth answered.
Swamishri perceived that the youth was ambitious, but he lacked confidence and the determination to accomplish his goal.

Swamishri gently explained, "Finish your studies and then get a job or start a business. And then slowly you can become an Ambani. It takes 100 years to become an Ambani. Till then a lot needs to be done and achieved. Run a small business to look after your family. One must also worship and say prayers to God. It is alright to have high thoughts, but because of that you have lost your balance. You keep thinking about what you cannot get. Instead, worship and chant the name of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Everything will happen. But for now, complete your M.Sc. And then you can progress gradually. Stop dreaming big now, and study for the present. God will bless you with strength. Pray to Bhagwan Swaminarayan that you can study well, work properly to support and serve your family, society and country and offer devotion to God to liberate your atma.
"Offering devotion and having refuge in God serves to liberate one's atma. And then whatever God gives, you can serve society. You have my blessings!"

In the evening Swamishri attended the farewell assembly held at the nearby football ground. Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Some people think that once the sadhus have gone, we will return to our work. But now one must try to do more (satsang). Those who do not do so already should come to the mandir, perform daily personal puja and do satsang reading. There should be no lethargy in offering devotion to God. Is one lethargic in worldly duties? If one wants to do something it is done. So, no matter what, always attend the weekly discourses.”
In the afternoon, Swamishri blessed 26 youths of Bochasan who were running to New Delhi for the inauguration of Swaminarayan Akshardham.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the murtis for the new BAPS hari mandir in Vastral, a suburb of Ahmedabad.
Means to stabilize one’s mind

25 September 2009, Amdavad A city official came with his son for Swamishri’s darshan and blessings. His son asked, “My mind wavers a lot. ”Swamishri blessed him and advised, “Never ever get depressed. Work hard and pray, and your mind will become stable. Turn five malas daily. Everything will work out fine. Do not despair.”
A youth came. He said, "I have recently divorced my wife. I keep remembering her very much. I find no peace anywhere. I have thoughts of suicide."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Nothing is achieved by dying. If you live, everything will be fine. So pray to God. May she be happy wherever she is, and you too should be happy."
A young man came. He said, "My wife and I have recently divorced. I keep remembering her a lot. I find no peace anywhere. I have thoughts of suicide."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Nothing is gained by dying. If you live, everything will be fine. So pray to Bhagwan. May she be happy wherever she is, and you too should remain happy."

Today, after darshan in the mandir, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was coming towards his office room, sadhus from abroad had lined up along the way. As soon as Swamishri passed by them, they began introducing themselves one after another:
"I am from England..."
"I am from America..."
"I am from Australia..."
"I am from New Zealand..."
"I am from South
Africa..."
Finally Gnanmanandas Swami, standing at the door of Swamishri's room, asked Swamishri, "Where are you from?"
"From Akshardham," Swamishri said at once.
Hearing this indication of the one who is beyond indication, everyone swayed with joy.
